results.name: Silk shader
results.description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Silk style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#0F0F0F, #474444, #2D2B2B, #333030). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
results.author: pixelfox.webstudio
